## Quick Summary

| Metric | Champion v5 | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|-------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Assessment

**Champion v5 retains title** — Better tuning stability (min 0.43 vs 0.05) and tighter drawdown control (-9.3% vs -11.2%).

The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` candidate shows promise with improved lockbox minimum (+19% better), suggesting the macro alpha signal has merit, but the tuning instability and drawdown degradation indicate it needs refinement before promotion.

## Ready to Execute

```bash
# Run in sequence:
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Suggested Focus for Next Cycle

1. **Investigate tuning min collapse** — 0.05 on candidate suggests one fold is severely underperforming
2. **Drawdown constraint** — Consider adding MDD penalty to objective if macro alpha exploration continues
3. **Hybrid approach** — Test shadow integration at reduced weight to capture lockbox gains while preserving stability

Shall I execute the next commands or dive deeper into any metric?
